notes: Source is an FFIEC index page plus an acquisition/scope note; it contains no shall/must/should/may modality language, so no obligation rows are extracted (fidelity rule: not invented). The scope note itself explicitly restricts extraction to the quarterly cadence datum ('Schedules are cited, not distilled'), so the internal Call Report schedules (e.g., liquidity schedules) are not separately distilled here. Related, non-liquidity-relevant forms listed on the same FFIEC index (FFIEC 002, 002S, 009/009A, 019, 030/030S, 101, 102 — covering foreign branches, country exposure, regulatory capital, and market risk) fall outside the ratified liquidity/bank-run scope and are therefore omitted from this extraction notwithstanding their presence in the source text. No reference to FR 2052a or Call Report Schedule-level detail appears in this source text, so no such citation/interaction could be produced verbatim.
